description.value: EbikeBC is Canada's premier electric mobility retailer, founded in 2015 by engineers seeking sustainable transportation solutions, specializing in e-bikes, e-trikes, e-scooters, conversion kits, and accessories. The shop operates a dedicated service center handling e-bike repair, diagnostics, battery refurbishment, and component installation. For touring cyclists on e-bikes, it is a specialist resource for parts and servicing in the Vancouver area.

raw_osm.description: Specializes in electric bike solutions, offering a range of e-bikes, conversion kits and accessories as well as electric bike, electric scooter, & lithium-ion battery repair services & installation.
raw_osm.name: eBikeBC

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active e-bike specialty retailer and service center with a dedicated repair page listing e-bike, e-scooter, and lithium-ion battery repair, with a phone number matching OSM. The accessories and parts catalogs confirm touring-relevant stock (racks, bags/panniers, fenders, tires/tubes), and e-bike service is explicitly described. No website content addresses floor pumps, walk-in policy, washrooms, or device/e-bike charging, so those remain null; the OSM community field says North Vancouver but postal code V5C 3V6 is in Burnaby, flagged as a concern.
concerns: OSM community field lists 'North Vancouver' but postal code V5C 3V6 is in Burnaby — community attribution may be incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, legitimate e-bike specialty shop with a service center and parts inventory; highly relevant to touring cyclists riding e-bikes in the Vancouver area.

Touring parts stocked.detail: Accessories catalog includes racks, bags/panniers, fenders, headlights, tail lights, and helmets; parts catalog includes tires & tubes

E-bike service.detail: Service page explicitly lists e-bike repair, diagnostics, installation/build, e-scooter mechanical/electrical repair, and lithium-ion battery repair and refurbishment

wow_evidence: dedicated service center handling e-bike repair, diagnostics, battery refurbishment, and component installation
